Professional Experience

Operations Manager – Sample Restaurant
- Directed comprehensive daily operations including staff scheduling, inventory coordination, vendor communications, customer issue resolution, and detailed reporting, ensuring consistent service quality and operational efficiency.
- Maintained operational stability during peak service periods by leading cross-functional teams and enforcing rigorous process discipline.
- Cultivated and managed strong vendor partnerships through proactive follow-up and coordination, securing uninterrupted supply chain operations.
- Resolved customer concerns promptly and effectively, enhancing guest satisfaction and reinforcing high service standards.
- Spearheaded improvements in stock verification procedures and shift handover processes, optimizing inventory accuracy and operational continuity.

Leadership Experience

- Led and motivated supervisors and front-of-house teams, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance aligned with service excellence.
- Managed team scheduling and workload distribution to maximize operational efficiency and maintain staff engagement.
- Promoted open communication and collaboration across teams to strengthen operational cohesion and service delivery.

Achievements

- Sustained stable and efficient restaurant operations during high-volume service periods, minimizing disruptions and maintaining elevated customer satisfaction.
- Enhanced stock check routines, significantly reducing discrepancies and improving inventory control accuracy.
- Streamlined shift handover processes, strengthening communication and operational continuity between teams.

Education and Certifications

Diploma in Hotel Management
Sample Diploma in Hospitality Operations
Food Safety Training Certification

Skills

Leadership & Management:
- Leadership, Staff Management, Team Coordination, Vendor Coordination

Operations & Execution:
- Operations Management, Stock Coordination, Scheduling, Customer Issue Resolution, Reporting

Tools & Systems:
- POS Systems, Excel

Compliance & Training:
- Food Safety Training
